title: My designs
empty: No designs yet. As soon as you create something it shows up here.
import_failed: The file could not be read.
autosave_hint: All designs are saved automatically. Use “Edit” to switch between them – nothing is overwritten.
quantity_hint: The number sets how often a design goes on the print sheet (0 = do not print).
empty_not_saved: Will be saved as soon as it has content
new_started: New design started – your previous one is in “My designs”.
